candidates.summary: A 16-year-old gunman entered Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend after shooting through locked doors, killing three children ages 5, 8 and 11 and a teacher. A 7-year-old child and a second teacher were hospitalized in critical condition. Authorities said a person at the scene followed the attacker inside and shot him; police found the attacker dead minutes after the first emergency call.
candidates.title: Four killed in shooting at Oregon elementary school

candidates.summary: Texas election officials said counties had cleared a voter-registration backlog caused by a state software problem before early voting. Officials did not give a statewide total but said hundreds of thousands of applications or updates had been delayed, including more than 75,000 in Harris County. The error prevented records submitted through the Department of Public Safety from reaching applicants’ home counties for processing.
candidates.title: Texas says voter-registration backlog has been cleared

candidates.summary: Hurricane Trudy continued strengthening south of Mexico. At 0000 UTC on October 16, the National Hurricane Center estimated maximum sustained winds of 90 mph, up from 75 mph early Thursday, with the center about 235 miles south-southwest of Acapulco. A hurricane watch covered part of Mexico’s Pacific coast, and forecasters expected rapid intensification.
candidates.title: Hurricane Trudy strengthens to 90 mph south of Mexico
